checks.name: actual_torch251_profiler_API
checks.detail: The installed READY2027 ledger records torch2.5.1+cu121. Official v2.5.1 source defines FunctionEventAvg.self_device_time_total, count, key and flops; key_averages returns these aggregates. None-valued per-event FLOPs do not replace the aggregate initial zero. No compatibility fallback is needed.

checks.name: profiler_coverage_and_observer_effect
checks.detail: Official v2.5.1 profiler accepts CPU/CUDA activities, record_shapes and with_flops; documentation restricts FLOPs estimates to selected operations and warns of observer overhead. Source reads timing peaks before the separate profiler forward and exposes unreported operators, lower-bound naming and complete_model_FLOPs=false.

checks.name: actual_dev_data_FP32_and_parameter_scope
checks.detail: split_records reads installed training directories and fixed identity-disjoint development identities; make_loader(False) has deterministic eval transforms, no shuffle/drop_last, so dev[:8] yields8 real triplets. Existing source resizes to SIZE_TRAIN; all three current YAML files have matching SIZE_TRAIN/SIZE_TEST. All model constructors finish float().cuda(), eval applies to all submodules, and inference_mode encloses every measured forward. Counts are all registered and all requires_grad parameters, not a claim that every counted parameter runs at inference.

checks.name: model_variants_and_zero_retrieval_selection
checks.detail: The five requested variants are complete DeMo, V4 axis/plain/frequency fullref and V5 relation-mass. Four enhanced counts/dimensions are checked at runtime. Existing constructors and source receipts retain the previously reviewed model allocation; this review does not repeat that review. Only public CLIP plus fresh ReID heads is used. There is no optimizer, backward, checkpoint selection, retrieval evaluation or official test path.

checks.name: physical_paths_and_import_resolution
checks.detail: READY ledger target_prefix and documented project/data paths match /data/gb/Re-ID on2027. collect_results.remote_python reads the locally overridden HOSTS2027 interpreter. Wrapper uses Python -c with project cwd and child invokes profile_reid_models.py from that cwd, making project-root imports resolvable. No shell source/env install, old-file upload, signals, other-host calls or other-GPU allocation are introduced.

harness_status: First full narrow harness passed; no harness failure occurred or was removed.
limitations: PASS gates the reviewed source/deployment sequence. This reviewer did not execute actual Torch, CUDA, datasets, SSH, uploads, installs, signals or the15 cost conditions.
Mock timing, memory and parameters are fixtures validating sequencing and units; they are not measurements or evidence of actual throughput, peak memory, initialized tensor equality or GPU release.

Measured wall latency includes CUDA-event recording and synchronization/dispatch overhead. CUDA event samples measure their own event interval. Both exclude input decoding and host-to-device transfer.

Peak allocated/reserved values are process allocator bytes after warmup, including the model, held inputs/output and any allocator reservation. They are not total nvidia-smi device memory or activation-only bytes.
One fixed batch of8 and20 sequential trials cannot establish broad serving throughput or latency percentiles; shared-host load remains a disclosed limitation.
Profiler FLOPs are selected-operator estimates only. No full-model FLOPs, equal compute from equal parameters, trained retrieval score or speed superiority is established.
Current remote source/resources are intentionally left to the runtime guards; a past READY receipt does not prove current GPU availability.
